recipes.name: Village salad with feta
recipes.method_note: No lettuce. Ripe tomatoes do the work.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:tomato-medium}} into wedges.
Halve {{ing:cucumber}} lengthways. Slice into thick half moons.
Slice {{ing:red-onion}} thinly. Slice {{ing:pepper-bell}} into rings.
Put everything in a wide bowl with {{ing:olives-pitted}}.
Lay {{ing:feta}} on top in one piece.
Pour over {{ing:olive-oil}}. Sprinkle with {{ing:dried-oregano}}.

recipes.name: Chicken souvlaki pittas with tzatziki
recipes.method_note: Marinate in the morning if you can. Twenty minutes still helps.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} into chunks. Put in a bowl.
Add the juice of half of {{ing:lemon}}, 2 crushed garlic cloves and {{ing:dried-oregano}}.
Stir in {{ing:olive-oil}}. Leave for at least 20 minutes.
Grate {{ing:cucumber}}. Squeeze out the water in your hands.
Mix the cucumber into {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} with the last garlic clove, crushed.
Chop {{ing:fresh-mint}}. Stir it in.
Put a griddle or frying pan on a high heat.
Cook the chicken for 10 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Warm {{ing:pitta-bread}} in a toaster. Slice {{ing:tomato-medium}} and {{ing:red-onion}}.
Fill each pitta with chicken, salad and tzatziki.

swaps.text: Firm tofu or a tin of chickpeas, for a vegetarian version
Coconut or soya yoghurt, to make it dairy free

recipes.name: Baked butter beans in tomato
recipes.method_note: Even better the next day. Eat warm with bread, or at room temperature.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Slice {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Heat {{ing:olive-oil}} in an ovenproof dish or pan on a medium heat.
Fry the onion and carrot for 10 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, {{ing:dried-oregano}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Drain {{ing:butter-beans-tinned}}. Stir them in with 100 ml water.
Bake for 40 minutes, until thick and bubbling at the edges.
Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Scatter over to serve.

recipes.name: Lamb meatballs with lemon and herbs
recipes.method_note: Wet hands stop the mince sticking as you roll.

steps.instruction: Grate {{ing:red-onion}}. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Chop {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Mix with {{ing:lamb-mince}}, {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:dried-oregano}}.
Roll into 20 balls, each about the size of a walnut.
Heat {{ing:olive-oil}} in a frying pan on a medium heat.
Fry the meatballs for 12 minutes, turning, until brown and cooked through.
Put {{ing:couscous-dry}} in a bowl. Pour over {{ing:stock-vegetable}}, boiling.
Cover. Leave 5 minutes, until the stock is absorbed. Fluff with a fork.
Serve the meatballs on the couscous with wedges of {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Green or brown lentils (a 400 g tin for every 250 g) or plant-based mince, for a vegetarian version
Quinoa or rice, to make it gluten free
